target.statement: WebLoop (Refine) with Qwen3.5-9B reaches 41.5 Overall on WebRise

compute.basis: The target is the trained WebLoop checkpoint evaluated after a full Generator-Critic-Refiner loop, which requires 9B-scale GRPO training on 3K executable web tasks plus browser-based execution, not a single inference run.

blockers: requires multi-GPU RL training of a 9B model with browser rollouts
training corpus (2,880 tasks), configurations, and data-construction assets are only promised upon acceptance
needs the WebRise/WebGen-Bench browser execution harness and Interaction Contract Graphs
no public trained WebLoop checkpoints are indicated in the paper
title: Learning the Loop, Not Just the Page: Execution-Grounded Loop Learning for Web Generation
